_comment: The requested cursor's name as the broker may report it, shared by tests/native_spike/test_text_cursor.py with both sides: spike/ownership/registry.cpp cursorShapeName (through ownership_test --cursor-name) gives `accepted` back unchanged and `refused` as nothing, and tools/native_spike/ownership.py CURSOR_NAME takes exactly `accepted`. The empty name is neither: it is how the broker says it has none.
